about_short_description.short_description: Sourcify is a manufacturing platform that directly connects customers with factories overseas.

product.name: Manufacturing Platform
product.description: A platform that connects customers with vetted overseas factories to source and manufacture products across various categories.

product.name: Product Sourcing School
product.description: An online education program teaching how to source, manufacture, and sell products, aimed at startups and businesses spending under $1 million annually on production.

product.name: Sourcing Consultation and Factory Matching
product.description: A service that matches customers with suitable factories and provides sourcing consultations to facilitate overseas manufacturing.

product.name: Production Management Software
product.description: Custom software that provides visibility and tracking of production progress between customers and factories.

product.name: Freight Forwarding Guidance
product.description: Advisory service on selecting and working with freight forwarders to ship products from overseas factories to customers' home countries.
